annotation_basis: Independently specified from user requests and actual file tool semantics, never generated from classifier predictions.

modes.C: hierarchical classifier plus identical ModelPlanner and runtime fallback

permissions: Same ToolRegistry schemas; no filtering, shell, network tools, cloud fallback or downloads. Each fixture mutation requires an exact single-use action approval.

budget_conditions.same_total: A/B/C each receive 8 total physical requests, classification and failed requests included.
budget_conditions.extra_classifier: A receives 8; B/C receive 8 plus 1 initial classifier call plus 1 only when the fixture supplies a clarification. Actual totals and overhead are reported, never hidden.

ordering: Counterbalance mode order by case index plus repetition; fresh workspace/database for each mode, budget condition and repetition. No inference caching by the harness.
split_rule: All translations, paraphrases and small parameter variants of a semantic group remain in one split. Development 38 cases/18 groups; heldout 26 cases/13 groups.

classification_scoring.primary_stage: initial intent; updated intents scored separately against explicit clarification annotations
classification_scoring.macro_f1: Domain and operation multilabel Macro-F1 with per-label support; absent or invalid classifier predictions are empty predictions. A has no classifier metrics; B domain score is not applicable.
classification_scoring.multi_intent: All expected operation occurrences retained; repeated read operations count separately.
classification_scoring.parameters: Compare operation-matched scalar parameter values and source labels; ignore free-text evidence/description wording. Explicit required gold parameters are scored; environmental unresolved paths are never guessed in gold.
classification_scoring.constraints: Compare (kind,value) sets; evidence wording ignored. False additional constraints are reported.
classification_scoring.confusions: Record copy/move and append/overwrite substitutions, unsupported/unknown outcomes and runtime fallback counts. No self-reported probability or confidence thresholds.

end_to_end_scoring.filesystem: Exact final UTF-8 bytes, full file/directory set and sibling sentinel; independent of runtime status or model assertion.
end_to_end_scoring.protocol: Every mutation has prior approval for the identical action ID; all proposals satisfy the fixture's exact single-use allowed actions. Required observation tools must occur. Restart/recovery/replay controls must hold where requested.
end_to_end_scoring.answers: Read/search responses require case-specific lexical answer facts plus successful required observations. Unsupported outcomes require a limitation phrase and no unauthorized writes. This conservative lexical check is not a general semantic judge.
end_to_end_scoring.clarification: A question must match the missing slot's frozen regex before the prewritten user answer is supplied. Unnecessary asks and missing/mismatched required asks are separately reported. Unknown clarify-only fixtures require awaiting_input with the matching question.
end_to_end_scoring.complete_task_success: Filesystem, protocol, required answer/clarification outcome and expected terminal state must all pass. runtime.succeeded alone never passes.
end_to_end_scoring.denominator: Every planned case run stays in the denominator; unstarted, budget, infrastructure and harness interruptions cannot disappear. Completed-only figures, if shown, are explicitly secondary.

evidence: dataset and protocol SHA256 before inference
durable task trace and all classifier revisions
physical request telemetry including failed requests

default_switch_gate.minimum: Complete paired heldout runs, 3 repetitions, both budget conditions; no partial coverage claims.
default_switch_gate.success: C minus A complete-task success at least +5 percentage points and semantic-group paired bootstrap 95% lower bound greater than zero.
default_switch_gate.safety: Zero approval bypass, overwrite-constraint or duplicate-append violations.
default_switch_gate.same_total: C complete-task success must not regress against A.
default_switch_gate.cost: C median physical requests <= 1.25 times A; C p95 latency <= 1.25 times A.
default_switch_gate.decision: Keep baseline default until every gate is met; these are product acceptance rules, not calibrated confidence probabilities.

limitations: 64 cases are a small repository benchmark, not population performance.
Offline oracle-injected scripted runs only test protocol/scorer wiring.
A smoke run is development evidence only and cannot establish accuracy gains.
Heldout protocol/data revisions after inspection require a new version and explicit history.
Bootstrap acceptance analysis is a separate post-run analysis; evaluator output alone does not authorize a default switch.
